deviations.description: Decision gate / hard stop: determine whether a minimal non-destructive reset of Logos/cur directory bookkeeping exists
deviations.reason: Phase 4 evidence disproved the plan's working premise entirely: there is no ghost/stuck directory record to reset. xapian-check found the DB fully healthy (no errors across all B-tree tables), and all 22 target UIDs already have live, correctly-tagged message documents. The database requires no repair of any kind. This resolves the decision gate as a clean NO-OP -- not a 'no non-destructive path found -> STOP' failure mode, but a 'nothing is broken, no repair needed or appropriate' resolution. No index-mutating action was taken.

notes: PHASE 5 RESOLUTION: No reset/repair is needed or appropriate. The Xapian database is fully healthy (xapian-check: 'No errors found' across docdata/termlist/postlist/position) and all 22 target files already carry live, correctly-tagged message documents (docid + PLogos/cur path term + full tag set including tag:trash). No index-mutating action was taken in this phase -- this is the clean 'no repair needed' resolution the plan's Phase 5 goal anticipates as one of its sanctioned terminal outcomes, distinct from the 'no non-destructive path found -> STOP' hard-stop outcome (which presupposes something IS broken but cannot safely be fixed). Final integrity spot-check: sha256 for 3 files (_145, _200, _305) re-verified against the Phase 1 baseline -- all three byte-identical, zero drift. No mail file was added, removed, renamed, or modified at any point in Phases 1-5; no message-document surgery was performed; all Xapian tooling used was ephemeral (nix shell nixpkgs#xapian) and read-only (xapian-check without --fix, xapian-delve). Final root cause: the 22 files are indexed and correctly tagged tag:trash; notmuch's search.exclude_tags (deleted, spam, trash) causes default searches to omit them, and task 852's on-disk-vs-indexed diff methodology used a trash-excluding search as its 'indexed set' probe, producing a false-positive 'unindexed' classification. Routing to Phase 6 for documentation.
